negative_findings.why_it_matters: Serbian coverage must be obtained by enumerating the CBK site's own 'SRB-' prefixed files and ?lang=sr variants rather than by open-web Serbian search.

negative_findings.description: No standalone public KIPS rulebook / participation agreement document was located; only the CBK web description of the four-phase accession process and the separate regulation on non-bank PSP access.
negative_findings.result_summary: The operational KIPS rulebook may be issued to participants rather than published on the open web.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Interbank clearing rules and cut-off/session changes would then be invisible to open-source collection and must be inferred from CBK web pages, annual reports, or industry sources.

negative_findings.description: Albanian-language queries aimed at law-firm alerts ('njoftim ligjor', 'buletin ligjor', 'ndryshimet në ligjin bankar', 'analizë avokat') returned almost exclusively primary sources (Gazeta Zyrtare, BQK PDFs, ATK presentations, Kuvendi) and NGO/think-tank analyses (GAP Institute, KCSF, IKD), not law-firm client alerts.
negative_findings.result_summary: No Kosovo law firm was found publishing a dated banking/payments legal alert in Albanian; the firms that do publish (RPHS, Vokshi & Lata) do so in English.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: It means the 'summarised before an English version exists' assumption of this cell is inverted for Kosovo: the firm layer is English-first, and the Albanian-first layer is regulators plus NGOs. Local-language monitoring for this cell should target regulator and NGO outputs, not firm newsletters.

negative_findings.description: No Serbian-language (sr) professional-interpreter source for Kosovo banking/payments regulation was located in this run; searches were executed in sq and en, and Serbian-language legal-advisory content addressing Kosovo (XK) regulation did not surface via the queries used.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero sr-language law-firm or advisory alert sources identified for this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Serbian-language coverage of Kosovo financial regulation is a stated run requirement; leaving it empty risks missing the northern-Kosovo/Serbia-facing advisory layer, which may interpret CBK rules differently.

negative_findings.description: For KPMG and EY, only office/overview pages were confirmed; the specific Kosovo tax & legal alert index URL was not observed. Deloitte's Kosovo alerts sit on the Albania (www2.deloitte.com/al) hub which is mid-migration to deloitte.com/ce, so the listing URL may redirect.
negative_findings.result_summary: PwC Kosovo has an explicit Tax News page; Deloitte has a confirmed Albania/Kosova alert index (possibly moving); KPMG and EY Kosovo alert indexes remain unlocated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without stable index URLs the crawler cannot reliably detect new alerts; a manual triage pass is needed before scheduling collection.

negative_findings.description: Beyond a single Lexology item on Draft Law 08/L-295 on Crypto-Assets, no systematic law-firm channel commenting on CBK/Ministry public consultations was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Firm commentary in Kosovo clusters after adoption ('law enters into force'), not during consultation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'consultations' topic in this run is poorly served by the professional-interpreter cell; consultation monitoring must lean on CBK/Kuvendi primary channels (other cells).

negative_findings.description: Searched in Albanian for a Klan Kosova and a Kosovapress business/economy desk covering BQK regulation. Neither outlet returned a banking-regulation article or an identifiable economy-section URL in any of the searches run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Klan Kosova surfaced only via its Wikipedia entry; Kosovapress returned no on-topic hits at all. No usable section URL recorded for either — deliberately not invented.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two of the outlets named in the cell definition are unconfirmed as regulatory-news sources; the cell's coverage therefore leans on Koha, Telegrafi, Ekonomia Online, Kallxo and Insajderi instead.

negative_findings.description: Explicit search for RSS/feed endpoints for the Albanian-language Kosovo outlets (Telegrafi, Zëri, Bota Sot, Ekonomia Online, Indeksonline) returned no feed URLs.
negative_findings.result_summary: No RSS URL was found for any Kosovo Albanian outlet in this pass; conventional WordPress /feed/ paths are a hypothesis only and were not tested.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection will likely have to rely on HTML section crawling rather than feeds, which is more brittle and more likely to trip bot defences.

negative_findings.description: No consistent Albanian term for a formal regulator public-consultation process surfaced in media coverage. 'Konsultim publik' and 'projektrregullore' returned government/agriculture and PDF regulation texts, not BQK consultation announcements reported by media.
negative_findings.result_summary: Media appear not to report BQK consultations as consultations; they report the finished rule or the cabinet approval of a draft law.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale in reverse: consultations that 'open quietly' may not surface in media at all, so the media layer cannot be the primary detector for consultation windows — the BQK site and the Prime Minister's concept-document repository must be.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language searching found KoSSev but did not surface Kosovo Online, Radio KIM or RTK2 with any banking-regulation content in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only one Serbian-language Kosovo outlet (KoSSev) confirmed with on-topic banking-supervision material.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Serb-bank licensing dispute is a major supervisory story with a single confirmed local-language channel; single-source risk.

negative_findings.description: Two domains appeared for Insajderi (insajderi.com and insajderi.org) and two for Koha's economy section (www.koha.net and apps.koha.net), and two for the Assembly (kuvendikosoves.org, assemblyofkosovo.org).
negative_findings.result_summary: Canonical hosts not determined; both variants recorded rather than guessed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A crawler pointed at the non-canonical host may silently collect nothing or duplicate content.

negative_findings.description: Direct WebFetch of https://bqk-kos.org/?lang=sr returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, so the Serbian-language section structure of the CBK site could not be enumerated in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: 403 on the regulator's own Serbian-language landing page; the site is clearly live (search engines index SRB-*.pdf regulation files under /wp-content/uploads/2025/12/), so this reads as bot defence, not a dead host. Recorded as unverified, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important source in this cell cannot be collected with a naive fetcher; the collection pipeline needs a browser-like agent or an allowlisted crawler, otherwise the entire Serbian-language regulatory feed silently returns nothing.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Serbian-language public-consultation portal or consultation register for CBK draft regulations was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in Serbian for CBK consultation terms surfaced only news coverage of finished decisions, not a konsultacije/javna rasprava page in Serbian. Kosovo's central government consultation platform (konsultimet.rks-gov.net) was not confirmed to carry CBK items or Serbian translations in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If draft CBK rules are consulted only in Albanian, Serbian-language monitoring will always be reactive — catching rules after adoption rather than during the comment window, which is precisely the deadline intelligence this workstream needs.

negative_findings.description: The Office of the Language Commissioner's canonical domain was not confirmed by a successful fetch.
negative_findings.result_summary: The institution and its 2024 complaint statistics were confirmed through KoSSev and UNS reporting, but its own website URL (zkgjnj.rks-gov.net) is inferred from the rks-gov.net naming convention and must be resolved by the verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This source is the structural indicator of Serbian-language publication compliance; an unresolved URL means the pipeline would fall back on second-hand media reporting only.

negative_findings.description: No Ombudsperson Institution (OIK) report or ex-officio case specifically on the Regulation on Cash Operations was found in Serbian.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search combining Ombudsman, Serbian-language report and cash-operations regulation terms returned only generic institutional pages; no matching document surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: An OIK opinion would be the most authoritative non-partisan assessment of the regulation's effect on Serb-majority municipalities; its apparent absence (or non-indexing) means this angle is currently covered only by advocacy sources on both sides.

negative_findings.description: No consistent Serbian-language terminology was found for CBK supervisory/enforcement actions against unlicensed payment providers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Enforcement in Serb-majority areas is reported in police/political vocabulary ('zatvorene filijale', 'zaplenjeno', 'nelegalna finansijska institucija') rather than supervisory vocabulary ('oduzimanje licence', 'nadzorna mera', 'sankcija'), so keyword lists built from supervisory terms will miss most events.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Keyword design for this cell must use police/political Serbian vocabulary alongside regulatory vocabulary, or enforcement events will be systematically under-collected.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language searching using the correct statutory phrasing (obavestenje klijentima, izmena opstih uslova poslovanja) returned almost exclusively Serbian and Montenegrin domestic banks (Addiko, OTP, Halkbank, Raiffeisen RS, Komercijalna, Banca Intesa, CKB), not Kosovo-licensed banks. No Kosovo bank was found publishing a structured Serbian-language customer-notice feed.
negative_findings.result_summary: The only Serbian-language artefacts located on a Kosovo bank domain were ProCredit's .sr e-banking manuals. NLB Kosovo, Raiffeisen Kosovo, TEB, BKT, BPB and Banka Ekonomike surfaced only sq and en surfaces in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If regulatory change reaches Serbian-speaking customers in Kosovo at all, it may do so through branch notices or Serbia-facing media rather than the web, creating a monitoring blind spot for northern-municipality payment and account-migration effects. It also risks a collector mistaking Serbian-domiciled bank results for Kosovo ones.

negative_findings.description: Searches for standalone compliance / AML / FATCA disclosure pages on the individual Kosovo bank websites (in sq using 'pajtueshmeria' and in en) did not surface dedicated per-bank compliance landing pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Compliance visibility in Kosovo appears to sit at the Kosovo Banking Association committee level rather than on individual bank sites; the banks' compliance content is embedded inside T&C and annual-report documents instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's 'compliance pages' sub-hypothesis is weaker than expected. Collection effort should be reallocated from per-bank compliance pages to T&C version diffs, tariff PDFs and parent-group Pillar 3 disclosures, which is where the regulatory signal actually lives.

negative_findings.description: Searches in sq for 2025/2026 SEPA and IBAN migration notices addressed to customers returned CBK/press-level coverage (pre-application completed, process suspended pending constitutional review of three laws) but no bank-issued customer migration notice.
negative_findings.result_summary: The only bank-level IBAN notices found (BPB, NLB converter) relate to the earlier domestic IBAN/XK05 numbering regulation, not to SEPA accession.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms SEPA has not yet reached the customer-notice stage in Kosovo. The first bank-issued SEPA customer notice will therefore be a genuinely high-value early signal that accession has moved from legal-harmonisation to operational implementation, and monitoring should be primed to catch it.

negative_findings.description: Two target pages did not fetch cleanly: ProCredit's news index returned HTTP 500, and TEB's njoftim-per-klientet permalink resolved to the site homepage rather than the article.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both are recorded as unverified hypotheses, not dead sources — their content was visible in search-engine indexes, indicating live-but-defended or moved-permalink conditions.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive liveness checker would wrongly drop two of the most important notice feeds in the cell. The verification pass should retry with browser-grade fetching and treat 500/soft-redirect as retryable.

negative_findings.description: No Kosovo bank was found to maintain a dated archive of superseded customer notices or previous terms versions as a browsable list.
negative_findings.result_summary: Historical reconstruction depends on incidental URL conventions (BKT /content/YYYY/MM/, TEB Cmimorja_DD.MM.YYYY.pdf, BPB wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/) rather than any publisher-provided archive.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Backfill of the regulatory timeline before the monitoring start date will be partial and must lean on web-archive snapshots; forward-looking snapshotting must start immediately or the history is unrecoverable.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Kosovo-based fintech or payments regulatory conference with a published agenda was found for 2026. The closest is the regional Balkan Payment Forum in Tirana and the Kosovo Banking Association's own Payments Forum.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on Kosovo fintech/payments conference agendas returned only regional and global event calendars plus the association's Payments Forum 2025 page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Payment-rule weak signals for Kosovo have to be picked up from the banking association's events and from regional forums where Kosovo speakers appear, rather than from a domestic fintech conference circuit that does not appear to exist.

negative_findings.description: bankassoc-kos.com (Kosovo Banking Association), the highest-value source in this cell, returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on every direct fetch attempt (both https://bankassoc-kos.com/events/ and https://www.bankassoc-kos.com/Al/trajnimet/), while its pages are indexed and serving content to search crawlers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two fetch attempts, two 403s. Content confirmed live and current via the search index (events dated into October 2026).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hypothesis: bot protection / UA filtering, not a dead site. The collector for this source must be browser-based rather than a plain HTTP client, otherwise the single most productive weak-signal channel in the cell will be silently empty. Do not mark this domain dead.

negative_findings.description: No GIZ Kosovo project specifically targeting banking regulation or financial-sector supervision was located. The only GIZ Kosovo financial project found ('Improving financial governance in Kosovo') addresses public financial management, not bank supervision.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both an Albanian-language and an English-language donor search returned only the good-financial-governance project; GIZ appears in Kosovo mainly on energy and ICT.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The seed query's assumption that GIZ is a live actor in Kosovo financial-sector regulation is not supported by what was found. IFC/SECO, the World Bank, the EU/ESCB consortium and the IMF are the actors actually visible in this space, and collection effort should be weighted accordingly.

negative_findings.description: No current USAID Kosovo project page on financial-sector regulation was found. The only USAID reference surfaced was historical — international banking supervision consultants funded by USAID helping establish Kosovo's banking supervision function, cited in an early BQK/BPK annual report.
negative_findings.result_summary: USAID appears only as a historical actor and as a general ICT-sector donor; no live project page for financial regulation was retrieved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Given the state of US development funding, USAID should be treated as a low-priority or dormant channel for this cell unless a live project page is later confirmed. Recording it as an assumed active donor would be a fabrication.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) searching returned no Kosovo-specific event, training or donor artefact. The one Cyrillic-script hit relevant to Kosovo was a Macedonian-language report of the regional ESCB/IPA programme in which Kosovo's central bank is a beneficiary, plus a Republika Srpska banking-agency page on the same programme.
negative_findings.result_summary: One sr/Cyrillic query executed; results skewed to North Macedonia, Serbia and BiH institutions rather than Kosovo bodies.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For this cell, Serbian-language material about Kosovo financial regulation appears to be produced mainly by non-Kosovo institutions covering shared regional programmes. Serbian-language collection should target regional/peer institutions and Serbian-language Kosovo outlets, not BQK itself, whose sr output was not observed in this run. sr coverage of this cell is genuinely thin and should be flagged as such rather than assumed.

negative_findings.description: The session's web-search budget (200 calls) was exhausted before two planned lines of enquiry could be run: World Bank FinSAC / Vienna Initiative workshop agendas involving Kosovo, and AMIK (Asociacioni i Institucioneve Mikrofinanciare të Kosovës) training and conference activity.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two queries were issued and refused by the search budget guard; no results obtained.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are plausible additional weak-signal channels for this cell (FinSAC runs supervisory workshops for SEE authorities; AMIK is the non-bank counterpart to the Banking Association and would carry MFI-regulation signals). They remain unexamined, not absent.

negative_findings.description: The CEF (Center of Excellence in Finance, Ljubljana) training-calendar URL could not be confirmed. Only the institution's homepage, an archived about-us page and its team page were surfaced, together with confirmation that Kosovo is one of its member constituencies.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches confirmed the institution and Kosovo membership but returned no calendar/learning-programme URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The source is recorded with reduced confidence and its collection method explicitly starts with locating the calendar path. It must not be treated as a confirmed feed.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Albanian for a CBK/BQK public-consultation page for draft regulations ('projektrregullore', 'konsultim publik', 'afati i komenteve') and for CBK entries on the central konsultimet.rks-gov.net platform.
negative_findings.result_summary: No CBK-run consultation register and no CBK consultation on the central platform surfaced. Results returned only finalised CBK regulation PDFs, plus consultation notices from unrelated bodies (Prosecutorial Council, Judicial Council). The central platform's institution filter is oriented to ministries and the PM Office; the CBK is an independent institution and appears not to consult through it.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If CBK secondary rules (rregullore) are not consulted on any indexed platform, deadline intelligence for the supervisor's own rulebook cannot come from a consultation feed — it must come from diffing the CBK rulebook index and from Wayback snapshots. That materially changes the collection design for A3.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language search for a commercial consolidated-law database covering Kosovo acts ('propisi', 'baza propisa', 'zakon o platnim uslugama').
negative_findings.result_summary: All commercial consolidated-law vendors returned (paragraf.rs, cekos.rs, porezionline.rs) cover Republic of Serbia legislation, not Kosovo acts. No Kosovo equivalent of a paid consolidation service was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: There is no commercial fallback if GZK consolidation lags. Kosovo version history is single-sourced on gzk.rks-gov.net plus web archives, which raises the value of our own snapshotting and makes GZK a single point of failure worth monitoring for availability.

negative_findings.description: The cell brief names the consultation platform 'e-Konsultimet'.
negative_findings.result_summary: The actual platform is 'Platforma e Konsultimeve Publike' at konsultimet.rks-gov.net (no 'e-' prefix, no hyphen). Verified by fetching about.php and consultationsList.php.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collectors keyed on an 'e-konsultimet' hostname would silently fetch nothing. Recording the correct host prevents a false-negative feed.

negative_findings.description: Fetched https://konsultimet.rks-gov.net/consultationsList.php to enumerate open consultations and deadlines.
negative_findings.result_summary: The page returned the filter interface (institution dropdown, open/closed status, date range, name search) but no populated result rows — results appear to load via a POST/AJAX step rather than in the initial GET.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive GET-and-parse collector will report zero consultations and look 'green' while collecting nothing. The collector must replicate the form POST or drive a headless browser.

negative_findings.description: Attempted plain fetch of the CBK legal-framework index https://bqk-kos.org/?id=121.
negative_findings.result_summary: HTTP 403 Forbidden. PDF paths on the same host are indexed by search engines and served. Hypothesis: WAF/user-agent filtering, site live. Recorded as unverified, NOT dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The primary rulebook index for the supervisor needs a browser-grade fetcher; otherwise the whole CBK leg of A3 silently fails.

negative_findings.description: Planned further Serbian-language queries (PKIE / Nacionalni program, 'konsolidovani tekst zakona Kosovo', Wayback CDX coverage for gzk.rks-gov.net) and an Albanian query on the Ministry of Finance consultation subpage.
negative_findings.result_summary: The session web-search budget (200/200) was exhausted before these ran. No results obtained; these are untested leads, not dead ends.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Serbian-language coverage of this cell rests on one executed sr query, so sr-side aggregators may be under-represented in this slice.

negative_findings.description: No standalone CBK public register page for payment institutions, electronic money institutions and registered AISPs was located, despite Regulation B15 and Art. 18 of the Law on Payment System obliging CBK to maintain and publish one. Searched in Albanian ('regjistri publik i institucioneve të pagesave dhe parasë elektronike') and English.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the legal obligation and the consolidated all-sector register PDF were found; no dedicated PI/EMI/AISP register URL surfaced in search results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Payments is the core commercial interest of this run. Without the PI/EMI/AISP register the fintech/PSP population cannot be enumerated from the regulator side, and the consolidated PDF may not break these classes out.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated CBK enforcement/sanctions bulletin or public list of imposed administrative-punitive measures per institution was found. Enforcement appears only as aggregate counts inside the annual report (e.g. 'in seven cases administrative-punitive measures were adopted' for 2020).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched sq ('masat ndëshkuese', 'shqiptimi i gjobave', 'njoftim vendim') and en ('CBK Kosovo enforcement measures sanctions'); no per-case notice page or register of sanctions surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Enforcement notices are the observable proof of which rules bite. If CBK genuinely does not publish per-case sanctions, enforcement intelligence for Kosovo must be reconstructed from annual reports, court reporting and media — a much weaker and lagging signal.

negative_findings.description: No separate 'annual supervision report' (a supervision-only annual publication, as e.g. Bank of Albania issues 'Raportet Vjetore të Mbikëqyrjes Bankare') was found for CBK Kosovo. Supervision appears as a chapter of the general Annual Report and via the Financial Stability Report.
negative_findings.result_summary: Albanian-language searches for 'raporti vjetor i mbikëqyrjes financiare BQK' returned the Bank of Albania equivalent, not a Kosovo one.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collector should not wait for an artefact that likely does not exist; supervision monitoring must instead target the Annual Report chapter, the Financial Stability Report and the monthly financial-system information report.

negative_findings.description: bqk-kos.org (and the env2.bqk-kos.org mirror) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to both WebFetch and curl with a realistic desktop browser User-Agent, on HTML pages. PDF assets under /wp-content/uploads/ were reachable in search indexing.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two independent fetch methods 403'd on the register hub page; the site is clearly live and indexed, so this is bot protection, not a dead site. Recorded as unverified, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any production collector for this cell must budget for a headless browser / anti-bot-aware fetcher for CBK HTML pages; a naive HTTP client will produce false 'source dead' signals across the most important domain in the cell.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) coverage of CBK registers is very thin. The only confirmed sr artefacts are the ?lang=sr annual report PDFs (Godišnji Izveštaj). No Serbian-language version of the licensed-institution register list, licensing pages or enforcement material was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query 'Centralna banka Kosova spisak licenciranih banaka mikrofinansijskih institucija registar' returned Wikipedia and CBK annual-report PDFs only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If sr is a required monitoring language, the register layer may simply not exist in Serbian, meaning sr coverage for XK must be sourced from the annual reports plus Serbian-language Kosovo media rather than from the regulator's register pages.

negative_findings.description: No CBK public-consultation portal or 'draft regulations open for comment' page was located in this pass, in either sq or en.
negative_findings.result_summary: Regulation PDFs were found in final form under /korniza-ligjore/rregulloret/ and /wp-content/uploads/, but no consultation index, comment deadline listing, or draft-regulation section surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: 'Consultations' and 'deadlines' are explicit run topics; if CBK consults only by direct letter to licensed institutions, forward-looking regulatory intelligence for Kosovo must come from the newsroom and from the industry association rather than a consultation register.

negative_findings.description: Direct WebFetch of the Assembly's own pages returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on two independent paths: https://www.kuvendikosoves.org/shq/projektligjet-dhe-ligjet/ and https://kuvendikosoves.org/shq/projektligjet/projektligji/?draftlaw=266.
negative_findings.result_summary: 403 on both attempts; the same URLs are indexed and summarised by search engines, so the host is almost certainly live and bot-defended rather than dead. Recorded as unverified, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Assembly register is the upstream half of this coverage cell. Any collection design must assume a browser-like client (headless browser or realistic UA/headers), and should keep the assembly-kosova.org / assemblyofkosovo.org mirrors as fallbacks.

negative_findings.description: No structured per-bill stage record (first reading date, second reading date, committee report link) could be confirmed for the banking law 08/L-304 or the Draft Law on Payment Services from search results alone.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sq and en for the 08/L-304 committee amendment report and for a first-reading record of the payment services bill returned no matching Assembly document.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The reading-stage timeline — the core of the 'when will the deadline clock start' question — is likely only visible inside the 403-blocked per-bill pages, so stage tracking depends entirely on solving the fetch blocker.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed, open API, or bulk-download endpoint was identified for either the Official Gazette (gzk.rks-gov.net) or the Assembly bill register.
negative_findings.result_summary: The GZK portal exposes advanced search, by-year browsing, a subscription option and mobile apps, but no documented machine interface was found; the Assembly site likewise showed none in search results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ingestion will be scraping-based and therefore fragile to CMS redesigns. The GZK mobile apps are the most promising lead for an undocumented JSON backend and should be investigated before committing to HTML parsing.

negative_findings.description: For the new Law No. 08/L-304 on Banks (Gazette Nr. 2 / 27 January 2026), only the CBK-hosted gazetted PDF (sq and sr) was located; the corresponding gzk.rks-gov.net ActDocumentDetail record was not identified in searches.
negative_findings.result_summary: CBK copies carry the full gazette header, but the canonical GZK ActID for this act remains unknown.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For a compliance-deadline product, the canonical gazette record should be the citation of record. An ActID resolution step (GZK search by title/number) is a required part of collection design.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language coverage of the parliamentary stage (as opposed to the final gazetted text) is thin.
negative_findings.result_summary: Serbian searches surfaced the sr register and session pages plus sr gazetted statute PDFs, but no sr-language committee amendment reports or sr per-bill stage pages for banking/payments bills.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: sr is a mandatory language for this run and an official language of Kosovo. If sr-language bill-stage documents genuinely do not exist, that is a structural property of the source landscape that downstream analysis must record rather than treat as a collection failure.

negative_findings.description: Searched specifically for a MONEYVAL mutual evaluation report (MER) for Kosovo and for Kosovo's MONEYVAL membership status.
negative_findings.result_summary: No MONEYVAL MER for Kosovo was found and Kosovo does not appear among MONEYVAL's members/jurisdictions subject to its evaluation procedures. Kosovo's AML/CFT compliance is instead assessed through the Council of Europe / EU joint 'Project against Economic Crime in Kosovo' (PECK, and PECK II), whose assessment, monitoring and follow-up reports are hosted on rm.coe.int and apply MONEYVAL-style methodology.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief assumes a MONEYVAL evaluation of Kosovo whose action-plan dates become national deadlines. That mechanism exists, but the publisher and document series are PECK/PECK II (plus the annual EU enlargement report), not MONEYVAL plenary follow-up. Monitoring the MONEYVAL evaluations page alone would produce a permanent false negative for Kosovo.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Albanian and English for a published, citable statement of Kosovo's AML reporting thresholds and filing deadlines (STR/SAR turnaround, cash-transaction reporting threshold, cross-border currency declaration).
negative_findings.result_summary: No page stating concrete thresholds or filing clocks was surfaced. The FIU report-online page does not list report types, thresholds or deadlines; it defers to the legislation section. The values presumably sit inside Law 05/L-096 and the individual udhëzime administrative PDFs, which were not opened in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Deadline logic is the core value of this cell. The deadlines are not on any index page and must be extracted from PDF full text, so collection design must include PDF text extraction, not just link monitoring.

negative_findings.description: Searched (sq/en) for a published Kosovo National Risk Assessment (Vlerësimi Kombëtar i Rrezikut) for money laundering and terrorist financing.
negative_findings.result_summary: The FIU legislation index lists a 'risk assessment reports' category, but no NRA document or dedicated NRA landing page was located in this pass. Search results surfaced only the older PECK assessment material and generic institution-level risk-assessment commentary.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The NRA drives the risk-based obligations imposed on banks (sectoral risk ratings, EDD triggers). Its absence from search results may mean it is unpublished, published only as an internal document, or buried in an FIU PDF listing — each implies a different collection strategy.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) searching for the Kosovo FIU produced almost no Kosovo-institution results.
negative_findings.result_summary: The query 'Jedinica za finansijsku obaveštajnu Kosovo sprečavanje pranja novca izveštavanje banke uputstvo' returned mostly Serbia's own APML/NBS and Republic-of-Serbia material, plus CBK regulation PDFs served under the ?lang=sr / /srpski/ paths. The correct Serbian acronym for the Kosovo body appears to be FOJ-K (Finansijska obaveštajna jedinica), but no sr-language FIU landing page was directly confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Serbian is an official language in Kosovo and the FIU site advertises a Serbian version, but generic sr queries are heavily polluted by Serbia-proper AML authorities. sr collection must be domain-scoped (site:fiu.rks-gov.net, site:bqk-kos.org, ?lang=sr paths) rather than keyword-driven, or it will silently collect the wrong jurisdiction.

negative_findings.description: The Albanian phrase 'masat kufizuese ndaj Kosovës' is dangerously polysemous.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searching for Kosovo financial sanctions returns two unrelated things: (a) Kosovo's own regime for implementing UN/EU financial sanctions against designated persons (Law 08/L-146, Law 03/L-183), and (b) the EU's political restrictive measures imposed ON Kosovo after the 2023 northern-Kosovo tensions. Kallxo coverage of the latter dominated the results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive keyword collector on 'masat kufizuese' + 'Kosovë' will mostly harvest EU-Kosovo political news, not the compliance obligations banks must screen against. Queries need disambiguating anchors such as 'lista e sanksioneve', 'personat e shpallur', 'ngrirje e aseteve', or the law numbers.

negative_findings.description: Direct text of Law 08/L-146 on international financial sanctions was not retrieved.
negative_findings.result_summary: The law is listed on the FIU legislation index, but neither its gazette page nor its PDF was opened in this pass; sq searching on the law number returned adjacent material only. No conclusion about availability should be drawn — this is unverified, not missing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Law 08/L-146 is the legal hook for national designations and asset-freeze timelines, which is where sanctions deadlines for banks originate. It should be resolved to a gazette ActID in the next pass.

negative_findings.description: Could not locate a canonical, directly-linkable ATK register page listing currently licensed/certified fiscal-device suppliers and certified device models.
negative_findings.result_summary: Press reporting names four historically licensed PEF suppliers (Gekos, Dukagjini, Enternet, Service Global) and states the list is published on the ATK website, but no direct URL for that register surfaced in sq or en searches; the ATK site also failed automated fetch on a TLS chain error.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The certified-supplier register is the single most decision-relevant artefact for a payments-hardware business entering or partnering in Kosovo; without a stable URL, monitoring must fall back on press and the SEF application portal.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language ('sr') searching returned almost no Kosovo-specific fiscal-device regulatory material; results were dominated by Republic of Serbia sources (purs.gov.rs, paragraf.rs, aktivasistem.com).
negative_findings.result_summary: The query 'poreska administracija Kosova fiskalne kase pravilnik uputstvo' surfaced only one genuinely Kosovo item — ATK's Serbian-language tax legislation compendium PDF — with the rest being Serbian national fiscalization rules that are out of scope and actively confusing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: 'fiskalne kase' and 'pravilnik' are high-noise terms for Kosovo: they retrieve Serbia's separate fiscalization regime. Any sr-language monitoring for this cell must be domain-scoped (atk-ks.org, gzk.rks-gov.net, dogana.rks-gov.net) rather than keyword-only.

negative_findings.description: Automated fetch of the primary ATK website failed on TLS certificate chain verification; the MFPT homepage returned an effectively empty document.
negative_findings.result_summary: https://www.atk-ks.org/ and https://www.atk-ks.org/njoftime/ both returned 'unable to verify the first certificate'; https://mf.rks-gov.net/ returned only a site title with no navigation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Both are hypotheses about collection mechanics, not liveness verdicts — the sites are clearly live given indexed content and working PDF links. The collection layer will need relaxed TLS chain handling and headless rendering for these two domains.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Kosovo e-invoicing (B2B/B2G electronic invoicing) portal or standalone mandate page was found distinct from the fiscalization framework.
negative_findings.result_summary: E-invoice obligations appear embedded within the fiscal-device instructions (e.g. UA Nr. 02/2018 covering electronic invoices for internet supplies) and within the emerging SEF architecture, rather than as a separate e-invoicing programme with its own portal.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Monitoring should therefore treat 'e-faturimi' as a subtopic of the fiscalization instruments rather than expecting a separate rule-making stream; a separate portal may appear later as SEF matures.

negative_findings.description: Several natural-language queries leak heavily into Albania (AL) rather than Kosovo (XK) sources.
negative_findings.result_summary: 'Ministria e Financave' and 'arkat fiskale' returned financa.gov.al, shqiptarja.com, ligjetebiznesit.al and alprofitconsult.al — Albania's separate fiscalization regime and ministry.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Kosovo queries must be pinned with 'Kosovë', 'ATK', 'MFPT', 'rks-gov.net' or domain filters, otherwise Albanian fiscalization deadlines will be mistaken for Kosovar ones — a material risk given both countries run Albanian-language fiscalization programmes.

negative_findings.description: No Kosovo Competition Authority decision, sector inquiry or commitment specifically on interbank/interchange fees (komisionet ndërbankare) was found in sq or en searches.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches surfaced only Albanian (AL) Competition Authority decisions on banks (e.g. Vendimi 174) and generic AKK pages; the specific interchange topic returned nothing for Kosovo. Kosovar media report an AKK preliminary investigation into banks with no published decision yet.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Interchange caps in Kosovo may still originate from the central bank rather than the competition authority; the cell must not assume an AKK interchange file exists until a decision register is actually reachable.

negative_findings.description: https://ak.rks-gov.net/ did not resolve (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND) from this environment.
negative_findings.result_summary: One failed DNS resolution against the domain that search engines consistently list as the AKK official site. Not confirmed dead; likely a network/DNS or geo restriction on this host.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The competition regulator is the highest-value node in this cell; a false 'dead source' verdict would silently drop interchange and bank-merger coverage. Must be retried by the deterministic verification pass from a different network.

negative_findings.description: No public register of qualified trust-service providers (ofrues të shërbimeve të besuara / qualified e-signature certificate issuers) for Kosovo was located at a stable official URL.
negative_findings.result_summary: Sources describe an eIDAS-aligned law supervised by the ministry responsible for information technology together with the information agency, and state that certified providers exist, but no official trusted list URL was found in sq or en searches.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Remote onboarding and e-contracting by banks depend on which providers are qualified; without a trusted-list source, e-signature compliance changes cannot be tracked at the provider level.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) versions of the primary regulator sites in this cell were not located.
negative_findings.result_summary: AIP is officially bilingual by name (Agencija za Informacije i Privatnost) and FSDK publishes at least one sr leaflet, but no sr-language decision or consultation sections were found on aip.rks-gov.net, fsdk.org, arkep-rks.org or konsumatori.rks-gov.net. sr coverage currently rests on media (KosovaPress /srb/) and the official gazette.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The run mandates sr coverage; if sr content genuinely does not exist on these sites, collection must rely on gzk.rks-gov.net sr act texts plus sr media, and this limitation must be recorded rather than treated as a search failure.

negative_findings.description: The consumer-protection portal konsumatori.rks-gov.net was reported by Kosovar economic media (Aug 2026) as the target of a cyber attack.
negative_findings.result_summary: Reported outage/compromise; the site was not fetched in this run, so its current state is unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The main consumer-protection publication channel for bank fee/disclosure enforcement may be intermittently unavailable; collection should include a fallback via mint.rks-gov.net and the official gazette.

negative_findings.description: No public, per-meeting agenda, minutes or 'jointly agreed follow-up actions' document for the EU–Kosovo SAA Sub-committee on Economic and Financial Issues and Statistics could be located; only EEAS press releases summarising each meeting were found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches surfaced press releases for the 5th, 6th and 7th sub-committee meetings but no underlying documents, no document register, and no fixed meeting calendar.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The follow-up action lists are the crispest EU-driven deadline artefact for Kosovo financial-sector rules; without them the pipeline must be reconstructed from press releases plus the next annual country report, losing several months of lead time.

negative_findings.description: No Kosovo-specific EU document was found that explicitly names DORA, MiCA or PSR as instruments Kosovo is scheduled to transpose.
negative_findings.result_summary: Targeted searches combining Kosovo with DORA / MiCA / PSD2 / PSR / AMLR against IPA and enlargement domains returned only generic IPA III financing announcements and no instrument-level commitment.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: It is a real possibility that Kosovo's EU-driven pipeline is currently anchored on older instruments (PSD2/AMLD, banking recovery and resolution) rather than the 2023–2025 acquis wave. Treating DORA/MiCA transposition as scheduled would be an unsupported assumption; this must be confirmed by reading the country-report chapters directly rather than inferred.

negative_findings.description: No Serbian-language (sr) Kosovo-government source for the EU-driven rule pipeline was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Serbian-language searching returned EU/EEAS and Serbia-focused material plus the CBK Serbian annual report, but no sr-language version of PKIE/PKZMSA or an sr Assembly EU-integration page was confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Kosovo is officially bilingual; an sr-language gap risks missing documents published only on the Serbian-language mirrors of rks-gov.net sites, and weakens coverage of the Serb-majority banking constituency.

negative_findings.description: Commission enlargement document URLs are opaque, UUID-based download links with a filename query parameter rather than stable permalinks.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two different UUID URLs were observed for the 2025 Kosovo Report; the 2024 report uses a third. No stable canonical URL pattern was identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any stored URL for a Commission country report is likely to break between cycles, so collection must resolve documents from the enlargement package landing page each year rather than by stored link, with ecoi.net as a fallback resolver.

negative_findings.description: A Serbian-language search using Cyrillic IFI terminology ('ММФ извештај Косово банкарски сектор супервизија препоруке') returned no Kosovo-specific IFI material; results were dominated by North Macedonia and generic supervision pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero usable Serbian-language sources for IFI reporting on Kosovo were found in this run. IFIs publish on Kosovo in English only; Serbian-language secondary coverage appears to originate from Serbia-based outlets that were not surfaced by this query.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The run requires sr coverage. If no sr-language IFI channel exists, sr coverage for this cell must come from Serbian-language media in Kosovo/Serbia, which needs a separate targeted query set (Latin-script Serbian, e.g. 'MMF izveštaj Kosovo bankarski sektor').

negative_findings.description: No Albanian- or Serbian-language versions of IMF, World Bank, EBRD, EIB or CEB reports on Kosovo were located; all primary IFI documents found are English-only.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language access to this cell is indirect only — via CBK press releases (sq) and Albanian economic press summarising the English originals.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any sq/sr monitoring for this cell must be built on national-counterpart and press proxies rather than on IFI sites themselves; collection design should not expect language toggles on IFI domains.

negative_findings.description: Direct fetch of the IMF Kosovo country page (https://www.imf.org/en/Countries/UVK) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as a bot-defence hypothesis, not a dead URL — IMF Kosovo content is clearly live and reachable via search results and direct PDF links on imf.org and elibrary.imf.org.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collection layer for imf.org needs a browser-grade fetcher or the elibrary/media PDF paths, otherwise the highest-priority source in this cell silently yields nothing.

negative_findings.description: The World Bank Projects & Operations list for Kosovo renders client-side; a static fetch returned only the page shell.
negative_findings.result_summary: No project rows retrievable without JS execution; the World Bank Projects API is the correct access path.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a naive HTML scraper from being scheduled against a source that would appear live but always return empty.

negative_findings.description: No full joint IMF-World Bank FSAP (Financial Sector Assessment Program) for Kosovo was found; the equivalent function is served by the IMF Financial Sector Stability Review (2019) and its 2025/2026 follow-up.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for a Kosovo FSAP surfaced only FSSR and TA reports.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Analysts should not wait for or search on 'FSAP' for Kosovo — FSSR is the correct document family and the correct search key.

negative_findings.description: Despite targeted Albanian-language searching ('Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës reagon draft rregullore BQK konsultim publik komente'), no dedicated page or archive of SHBK formal comment letters on CBK draft regulations was surfaced. Search results for that query returned only CBK's own regulation PDFs.
negative_findings.result_summary: SHBK regulatory engagement appears to be documented indirectly (committee mandate text, joint workshops, magazine articles) rather than as a published consultation-response library.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The most decision-relevant artefact for this cell — a comment letter naming contested articles and requested deadline extensions — may only exist inside CBK consultation files or member-only areas, so collection must lean on konsultimet.rks-gov.net, CBK consultation pages, and media coverage instead.

negative_findings.description: Both peak sector associations — bankassoc-kos.com and amik.org — returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to plain fetches, while their sub-pages are indexed and served in search results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two 403s recorded; treated as bot defence, not as dead sites.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated collection of the two highest-value sources in this cell will need browser-emulating fetchers; a naive crawler would wrongly mark them offline.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language searching for a Kosovo banking or microfinance association ('Udruženje banaka Kosova', 'udruženje poslodavaca', 'propisi') found no sr-language banking-industry association for Kosovo. Only a general Serbian-language chamber structure (Privredna komora Kosova i Metohije) and Serbia-side chambers surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: No sr-language equivalent of SHBK/AMIK exists as far as searching could establish.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: sr-language coverage of industry self-organisation in this cell is structurally thin; sr-language signal on financial regulation must be sourced from minority media (KoSSev, Kosovo Online, RFE/Slobodna Evropa) and the CBK's own sr-language regulation pages rather than from an association.

negative_findings.description: The AmCham Kosovo site listed committees including Defense & Security and Life Sciences & Healthcare; no dedicated banking or financial-services committee was visible on the fetched page, although banks (BKT, NLB Banka, TEB) are patron members and AmCham sits on Finance/Tax/Customs consultative councils.
negative_findings.result_summary: Financial-services advocacy at AmCham appears to run through general fiscal/economic councils, not a named banking committee.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection should target AmCham's tax and economic-policy output rather than searching for a banking committee that may not exist.

negative_findings.description: Searching for Aleanca Kosovare e Bizneseve returned only a regional-office site (akb-gjakove.com) plus heavy media coverage; the national AKB web domain was not established within this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: AKB is trackable via media but its authoritative own-site channel is unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without the national domain, AKB positions can only be collected second-hand, losing the full text of any statement.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language coverage of this cell is thin: only the Serbian board-decisions page, the Serbian law text, Serbian reporting instructions and a Serbian financial-stability section were located. No Serbian-language term for draft regulation ('nacrt uredbe', 'javna konsultacija') was tested against the BQK site.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run explicit sr queries: 'nacrt uredbe CBK Kosovo banke', 'javna konsultacija CBK uredba', 'stupa na snagu uredba banke Kosovo', and map sr slug family (o-cbk, pravni-okvir, finansijska-stabilnost, nadzor).

coverage_gaps.description: The industry/trade-body layer is entirely missing: no banking association, no chamber of commerce financial-services committee, no bank-side compliance commentary was confirmed for Kosovo.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search sq for 'Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës', 'Asociacioni i Bankave', plus AmCham Kosovo and Oda Ekonomike financial-services committee positions on BQK regulations; find the association's real domain.

coverage_gaps.description: No structured route was established for extracting compliance DEADLINES specifically. Deadlines live inside PDF closing articles ('Kjo rregullore hyn në fuqi ...', transitional provisions) rather than in any list or table.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a PDF full-text rule that extracts 'hyn në fuqi', 'zbatohet nga', 'afati', 'dispozitat kalimtare' (sq) and 'stupa na snagu', 'primenjuje se od', 'prelazne odredbe' (sr) into a dated deadline register.

coverage_gaps.description: Board-decision posts were observed under at least three different URL shapes across years (bare slug pre-2021, /news/ prefix ~2022, /vendimet-e-bordit-bqk/ prefix 2026), implying past CMS migrations and possible link rot in the historical series.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Backfill the board-decision series via a site-wide slug scan and the Wayback Machine (web.archive.org/cdx for bqk-kos.org) rather than assuming one stable listing path.

coverage_gaps.description: The single most important domain for this cell (bqk-kos.org) is WAF-protected against simple fetchers, and no alternative authoritative mirror of its regulation set was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Provision a headless-browser collector for bqk-kos.org before the collection phase, and register the Wayback Machine as the fallback text source for instruments that cannot be fetched live.

coverage_gaps.description: Internal BQK actors were only partially mapped: Departamenti i Licencimit dhe Standardizimit and Departamenti për Mbikëqyrjen Bankare were identified, but the Bordi i BQK-së vs Bordi Ekzekutiv distinction (both appear in decision titles across years) and the department that owns rule-drafting were not resolved.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl the BQK organisational-structure pages (sq /rreth-bqk/, sr /o-cbk/) and the annual report to fix the actor map and know which body's decisions are binding rulemaking versus internal administration.

coverage_gaps.description: The Constitutional Court docket was included on the strength of press reporting about three blocked laws, but its listing pages were not retrieved in this run and the specific case references were not identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search gjk-ks.org for referrals concerning the payments/financial-sector law package and record the exact case numbers and expected decision dates.

coverage_gaps.description: CBK reportedly approved ~20 new regulations for SEPA alignment (Board approvals in late 2024 and June 2026), but only a handful of individual PDFs were identified. The full B-series enumeration is not yet mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the B-series file naming pattern (B1..Bn) across /wp-content/uploads/ month folders and the 'Rregulloret' index in sq/sr/en to build the complete payments regulation inventory with adoption and effective dates.

coverage_gaps.description: DG FISMA / European Commission is an explicit gatekeeper of Kosovo's SEPA application (it reviewed the pre-application and issued informal comments), but no specific Commission publication channel for that assessment was identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add the EU enlargement package Kosovo report (Chapter 4 free movement of capital / Chapter 9 financial services) and DG FISMA news as monitored sources for the SEPA decision point.

coverage_gaps.description: Card scheme, processor and switch-level rules (national card switch, interchange regulation, POS acquiring rules) were not covered by this run's queries.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass on 'komisioni ndërbankar' / interchange, national card switch interoperability, and any CBK rule on merchant service charges.

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/Atom feed or open API was identified for CBK regulations, the Official Gazette, or the Assembly draft-law tracker.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test for hidden WordPress feeds (/news/feed/) on bqk-kos.org and for gzk.rks-gov.net query endpoints; otherwise plan for HTML-diff based monitoring.

coverage_gaps.description: No Serbian-language professional-interpreter sources identified for Kosovo banking/payments/AML.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted sr/Cyrillic queries ('правни билтен Косово банкарски закон', 'правна анализа платни промет Косово', 'адвокатска канцеларија Северна Митровица') and check Serbian regional firms (Karanovic & Partners, JPM, BDK Advokati) for Kosovo-desk publications.

coverage_gaps.description: Boga & Associates and Kalo & Associates candidate URLs are inferred from firm names, not observed; their publication sections are unconfirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve canonical domains via their Legal 500 / SEE Legal / Chambers profile outbound links, then confirm the presence of a newsletter or legal-update index before scheduling collection.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn appears to be a real distribution channel for Kosovo firms' alerts (Grant Thornton Kosovo and CBK both maintain active company pages) but was not systematically covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add LinkedIn company-page monitoring for Deloitte Kosova, PwC Kosovo, KPMG, EY, Grant Thornton Kosovo, RPHS Law and Vokshi & Lata, subject to platform ToS — many alerts are posted there before or instead of on the firm website.

coverage_gaps.description: Fiscalization-specific Kosovo commentary from the audit/consultancy layer is thin in what was found; most fiscalization material surfaced from vendor blogs and TAK itself rather than Big Four alerts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query specifically for 'fiskalizimi', 'pajisje elektronike fiskale (PEF)', 'kupon fiskal', 'ATK EDI' combined with each Big Four and next-tier firm name; also check invoicing/e-fiscal vendor compliance blogs as an adjacent interpreter layer.

coverage_gaps.description: In-house/association interpreters (Kosovo Banking Association, AmCham Kosovo, compliance-officer associations) were not covered in this cell but perform the same rule-translation function.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check whether the Kosovo Banking Association (Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës) and AmCham Kosovo publish member circulars or position papers on the new Law on Banks / Law on Payment Services and their deadlines.

coverage_gaps.description: No broadcast-media source confirmed (RTK, Klan Kosova, T7, Dukagjini TV news bulletins). Parliamentary hearings and governor questioning are often broadcast before being written up.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass on Kosovo TV broadcasters' YouTube channels and web news desks in Albanian; look for committee-session recordings.

coverage_gaps.description: Industry-voice sources absent: the Kosovo Banking Association (Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës) and the Kosovo Chamber of Commerce were not searched for in this cell, yet they are the parties that publicly contest draft rules in the Albanian press.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search sq for 'Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës reagon rregullore' and add the association's press page as a source.

coverage_gaps.description: Kosovo news portals frequently restructure URLs and drop archives; several regulatory stories are only reachable via search engines.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Archive every collected article URL to a web archive at capture time rather than relying on the publisher's persistence.

coverage_gaps.description: No source URL in this slice has been tested for liveness or bot defences; several Kosovo portals are known to be aggressive with rate limiting.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass; treat any 403/timeout as bot-defended-but-live and retry with a browser-based fetcher before marking anything dead.

coverage_gaps.description: Turkish-language Kosovo media (a recognised community language, and relevant given Turkish bank presence such as Türkiye İş Bankası's Kosovo branch acquisition) were not covered by this cell's sq/sr/en mandate.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Consider a small Turkish-language pass for Kosovo outlets covering Turkish-owned bank licensing/acquisition approvals.

coverage_gaps.description: It is unknown how complete and how timely the Serbian-language mirror of CBK regulations, consultations and deadline notices actually is relative to the Albanian original.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a parity monitor: enumerate CBK regulation PDFs by language prefix (SRB-*, Albanian, ENG-*) and record, per instrument, whether a Serbian version exists and its publication lag in days.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed Serbian-language channel for draft regulations under consultation was found, leaving the pipeline able to see only adopted acts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Investigate konsultimet.rks-gov.net for CBK entries and language variants; if absent, treat the CBK Serbian news feed plus KoSSev as the only early-warning proxies and flag consultation coverage as structurally weak for sr.

coverage_gaps.description: Kosovo-licensed commercial banks (e.g. NLB Banka, Raiffeisen Kosovo, TEB, ProCredit, Banka Ekonomike) were not profiled for Serbian-language customer communications, branch/ATM rollout in the four northern municipalities, or mobile banking units — yet they are the entities that had to operationalise the euro-only rule.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated pass over Kosovo commercial bank sites and the Kosovo Banking Association (Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës) checking for Serbian-language pages, northern branch/ATM network announcements and fee schedules for currency exchange.

coverage_gaps.description: No statistical or supervisory dataset was identified that quantifies cash/currency-exchange volumes or banking penetration specifically in Serb-majority municipalities.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check CBK statistics/financial-stability reports and the Kosovo Agency of Statistics for municipality-level financial indicators, and NBS reports for dinar volumes designated for Kosovo; record explicitly if no municipality-level breakdown exists.

coverage_gaps.description: Most retrieved Serbian material was Latin-script; NBS and some Serbian-state sources publish in Cyrillic (e.g. the NBS media-questions page on unilateral measures).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure all Serbian keyword lists are duplicated in Cyrillic (динар, платни промет, Народна банка Србије, Централна банка Косова) and that transliteration-normalising matching is applied at collection time.

coverage_gaps.description: Most confirmed evidence clusters around the Jan-May 2024 introduction and enforcement wave; the current (2025-2026) state of enforcement, any amendments to the Regulation on Cash Operations, and the fate of a dinar payment workaround are not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a recency-scoped follow-up sweep in Serbian for 2025-2026 amendments, CBK licensing decisions for the north, and outcomes of EU-facilitated dialogue on payments.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language coverage of the private-bank notice channel is effectively absent; no Kosovo bank sr notice feed was located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Directly probe each bank domain for /sr/, ?lang=sr and .sr document variants rather than relying on search engines, which drown Kosovo results in Serbia-domiciled banks. Add negative filters for .rs domains in any sr-language query.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell named seven banks but Kosovo's licensed bank population is larger (Ziraat Bank Kosova SHA, Fibank Kosova, and others on the CBK register were found in this pass and are not in the named seven).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Derive the monitoring perimeter from the CBK list of licensed financial institutions rather than from the fixed seven-bank list, and refresh it monthly so conversions and acquisitions (Ziraat branch-to-SHA, Banka Ekonomike acquiring the Turkiye Is Bankasi branch) update the crawl set automatically.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank T&C documents state that legally valid notification may be delivered by SMS, e-mail, e-banking inbox, branch posting or newspaper advertisement — channels that are invisible to any web crawler.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Complement web monitoring with a Kosovo print/online press watch for bank tariff and terms advertisements, and consider maintaining live retail accounts at one or two banks so the e-banking inbox channel is observable. Treat web-only coverage as a partial, not complete, view of the notice population.

coverage_gaps.description: No publisher-side archives exist, so version history depends on URL-path conventions and third-party web archiving.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Begin immediate weekly snapshotting of every T&C and tariff URL in this slice; backfill opportunistically via web-archive queries against the same paths.

coverage_gaps.description: The consultations topic is only weakly covered by this cell: banks publish rules once final, not while draft. The Kosovo Banking Association's Compliance and AML committees are the plausible route into draft-stage commentary but no published consultation responses were located.
